title: Venetian Bronze Multi Hook, 15.5-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass 6 Position Tie & Belt Rack, Mercury Collection, Allied Brass
description: Multi hook 15.5-inch wall mount rack for bathroom organization: 6 position tie and belt rack that also works as a bathroom hook rack for robes, towels, and jackets — available in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This wall-mounted multi hook (wall mount / wall-mounted) is crafted from solid brass with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look. Dimensions: 15.5 inches long (15.5-inch, 15.5in) x 3.2 inches high x 4 inches wide. Weight capacity: 2 lb. Includes the multi hook and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Contemporary, transitional bathroom hardware style that saves space and keeps daily essentials within reach. Designer finish for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Mercury collection for matching Mercury and versatile bath accessories.
